themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are using upcoming elections and parliamentary votes to project power and demand government participation. In Sweden and Norway, right-wing populist parties are leveraging budget negotiations and coalition votes to position themselves as indispensable kingmakers, while Vox and AfD drive intense campaign messaging ahead of key electoral tests in Spain and Germany.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Holds the balance of power as Prime Minister Kristersson faces a crucial parliamentary vote amid growing coalition rifts.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Campaigns aggressively ahead of the November 29 general election, framing itself as the only uncompromising conservative option.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Demands early federal elections while nominating candidates for key state leadership positions in Saxony-Anhalt.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Capitalizes on budget negotiations to pressure the ruling coalition and position Sylvi Listhaug for the premiership.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Positions Marine Le Pen as the frontrunner for the 2027 presidential race while fending off rival right-wing challengers.

themes.title: Transnational Conservative Alliances and Bilateral Right-Wing Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Right-wing figures and administrations are actively engaging in high-profile international travel and bilateral diplomacy to bolster their domestic standing and international influence. While leaders like Argentina's Javier Milei and Poland's Karol Nawrocki undertake official visits abroad to build strategic partnerships, opposition figures like Hungary's Péter Magyar deploy overseas diplomacy in Ukraine to challenge incumbent foreign policy lines.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: President Milei conducts extensive foreign travel and bilateral summits in Paraguay despite diplomatic friction with Brazil.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: President Karol Nawrocki embarks on an official state visit to Chile focusing on energy security and trade relations.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Péter Magyar conducts a high-profile diplomatic visit to Ukraine to meet President Zelenskyy, contrasting with Orbán's policy.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Prime Minister Meloni leads EU summit talks in Brussels and engages in bilateral security diplomacy with Ukraine.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: State institutions, judiciaries, and law enforcement agencies across multiple nations are executing legal actions, investigations, and regulatory oversight against right-wing parties and officials. Right-wing media outlets consistently frame these measures—ranging from passport seizures in Brazil to anti-corruption raids in Poland and intelligence surveillance in Germany—as establishment lawfare designed to suppress political opposition.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Supreme Court judges order passport destructions and initiate new investigations into key Bolsonaro allies and federal deputies.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Anti-corruption authorities conduct raids on state-owned firms linked to the previous PiS administration while seeking presidential testimony.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Judicial authorities place prefects and prosecutors under investigation over sensitive intelligence leaks sent to RN politicians.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD members face weapon permit revocations, institutional bans, and security checks due to official extremism classifications.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Prime Minister Meloni clashes publicly with the judicial council over binding rulings regarding magistrate compensation.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across multiple regions are reinforcing restrictive immigration platforms, pressing for mass deportations, tighter border controls, and the prioritization of native citizens. From AfD calls for deporting millions of asylum seekers to Reform UK's proposals to eliminate visa routes and Vox's zero-tolerance rhetoric, anti-immigration remains a central unifying theme.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Party leadership calls for the mass deportation of over 2.6 million refugees and asylum seekers back to their home countries.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands an immediate halt to all irregular immigration and warns against cultural substitution ahead of the upcoming election.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Announces plans to abolish graduate visa routes and enforce drastic reductions in legal migration numbers.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Executive efforts to restrict birthright citizenship face legal challenges and temporary judicial injunctions.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Pushes to tie budget approvals to stricter repatriation incentives and reduced state spending on asylum integration.

themes.title: Pensions Overhaul and Fiscal Populism Debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing populist parties are advocating for aggressive fiscal relief, tax reductions, and cost-of-living protections to shield working-class and small-business voters from economic strain. In Norway, Sweden, Italy, France, and Argentina, parties are prioritizing tax cuts on essential goods, fuel duty relief, and pension protections in legislative battles.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Proposes a 63-billion NOK budget alternative cutting fuel duties, road tolls, and food VAT in half.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Submits a budget motion focused on lowering petrol and diesel taxes and increasing household disposable income.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Navigates complex budget bill negotiations involving healthcare spending limits, tax credit rules, and pension agreements.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Promotes local tax cuts and federal budget discipline while facing public pushback over university and pension spending.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Pledges a freeze on social contribution increases for small businesses to appeal to independent employers.
